task1.title: How to Apply for a Driving License
task1.prompt: You are required to write a letter to a friend explaining the process of applying for a driving license in your country. Include details about necessary documents, the steps involved in the application, the costs involved, and any tips that might help them during the process. Make sure to keep your letter informative and structured so that your friend can easily understand what they need to do.

task2.title: The Impact of Technology on Communication
task2.prompt: In today's world, technology has greatly changed the way we communicate with one another. Some people believe that these changes have had a positive impact, while others think they have created more problems than solutions. Discuss both the advantages and disadvantages of technology in communication. Provide relevant examples to support your views, and conclude with your own opinion on whether the benefits outweigh the drawbacks.
